headline: Peace talks are in doubt as the U.S. seizes an Iranian ship
summary: Trump said a U.S. delegation will travel to Pakistan to resume talks to end the war with Iran, but Tehran expressed reluctance after the U.S. seized an Iranian cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key global oil shipping chokepoint, so any disruption there feeds directly into crude supply and prices.

source.name: NPR News and Music for northeast Louisiana | KEDM

sources.name: NPR News and Music for northeast Louisiana | KEDM

why_moved: The seizure of an Iranian vessel threatened the ceasefire and raised concerns about crude oil supply disruption in the Gulf.
